files/runtime/prepare-trust.py:
"""Merge public roots only; no application secrets or network calls."""
from pathlib import Path
import ssl
roots=Path('/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt').read_bytes()
for name in ['redis','qdrant','kafka']:
    ca=Path('/etc/yeodam/ca',name+'.crt').read_bytes()
    if b'PRIVATE KEY' in ca:raise SystemExit('Public certificates only')
    roots+=b'\n'+ca
ssl.create_default_context(cadata=roots.decode())
Path('/etc/yeodam/trust/ca-bundle.pem').write_bytes(roots)
files/runtime/start-api.py:
"""Use the unchanged AI image with Cloud's reversible maintenance adapter."""
import os
import uvicorn
from runpod_control import install

control = install(int(os.environ['JOBS_STORY_CONCURRENCY']))
from app.v2_main import create_app

if __name__ == '__main__':
    uvicorn.run(control.middleware(create_app()), host='0.0.0.0', port=8000, timeout_graceful_shutdown=35)
files/runtime/start-runner.py:
"""Prepare the existing index, then run the controlled process loop; never load a GPU model here."""
import os,sys,asyncio,signal
from pathlib import Path
from app.jobs.config import JobsSettings
from app.infra.place_index import prepare_place_index
cfg=JobsSettings()
path=prepare_place_index(cfg)
if path is None or path.stat().st_size!=1098801152:raise SystemExit('Reference index not ready')
Path('/tmp/place-index-ready').write_text(cfg.PLACE_INDEX_SHA256)
print('Place index ready: bytes=1098801152',flush=True)
from runpod_control import install
install(1)
from app.jobs import runner
async def serve():
    task=asyncio.create_task(runner.main())
    asyncio.get_running_loop().add_signal_handler(signal.SIGTERM,task.cancel)
    try:await task
    except asyncio.CancelledError:pass
asyncio.run(serve())
